assumptions.choice: Pure Python single-hidden-layer MLP (3 inputs, 8 hidden units, 7 outputs)
assumptions.reason: Execution environment restricts imports to standard library and backtrader, prohibiting external deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

assumptions.choice: 100 episodes for offline DQN training in start()
assumptions.reason: Specification dictates epsilon decay of 0.99 per episode starting from 0.8, but does not specify total episode count. 100 episodes provides sufficient convergence while executing quickly.

assumptions.choice: 7 discrete actions: [Buy 100, Buy 50, Buy 10, Hold (0), Sell 10, Sell 50, Sell 100]
assumptions.reason: Specification requires dynamic share quantities between 0 and 100 for buy/sell actions.

assumptions.choice: First 252 daily bars used as 1 year of training data
assumptions.reason: Specification requests training on one year of historical daily timeframe data.
